policy: All profiles share ingestion, lifecycle, temporal normalization, 32-item/6000-token evidence limits and fixed Answer/Judge. Facts disables dedicated raw-source candidates; sources enables them; rerank adds candidate reranking; coverage adds diversity packing. Relation expansion and event projection are held off for this E2/E3 ladder. Reuse ingestion only when every original add succeeded; independent fresh runs and their errors remain separate. Existing development data is exposed regression data, not a fresh holdout. Verification additionally requests a strict four-array JSON Schema envelope. Local semantic, reference and completeness validation remain mandatory; unsupported gateways fail explicitly. Semantic erasure binding uses the verification model within the existing shared 90-second model budget. Requires fresh v3 representation; no in-place migration or reuse of v2 ingestion. Source erasure additionally checks whole raw messages and lexical fact candidates with exact original-text partitions using the verification model within the same total budget. Fresh v4 directories required; no v3 ingestion reuse.
